title: Remembered approvals and protected program files
summary: Approve all remembers your choice across tasks, chats and AI sites. Program files and future updates are checked for changes automatically.
improved: Program files are protected with signed checks and less readable browser code, without a new login, setup step or internet requirement.
fixed: Approve all remembers that tool type until you remove it under Safety > Always approved.
notes: Your own skills, notes and settings stay editable. Reload the extension and refresh AI tabs after the complete update.
Windows has no publisher signature. macOS keeps its existing local signature and is not notarized.
